premises.text: Parking is a significant problem causing traffic congestion.
premises.evidence_span: half of the traffic in Brooklyn is actually caused by people circling for a parking spot

premises.text: Curb Karma is a smartphone app that facilitates a social network for parking.
premises.evidence_span: Curb karma is an app for your smartphone available for the very first time today

premises.text: Users can reserve parking spots through the app using karma credits.
premises.evidence_span: Marissa can find and reserve Heather's parking spot

premises.text: Karma credits incentivize users to share their parking spots.
premises.evidence_span: Heather can earn something called a karma credit

premises.text: Curb Karma can generate significant revenue from parking exchanges.
premises.evidence_span: we make $400,000 a year in revenue

premises.text: There is a large market opportunity for Curb Karma in multiple cities worldwide.
premises.evidence_span: we're looking at a $30 million revenue opportunity, and that's just in one city

value.text: Curb Karma provides a solution for efficient parking management.

notes: No separate premises for user interactions as they are part of the app's functionality.
